calls.reason: ConStat and the ~100-study review show contamination and gaming are real, but METR's time-horizon work shows benchmarks can track progress, and nothing measures how often gains fail to transfer. It is also partly opinion.
CoreWeave's audited 2025 cash flows show $10.3B cash capex less $3.1B operating cash, about $7.3B net burn, far below $15B. The $14.9B figure is gross capex, not a loss.
The filing confirms concentration: top two customers gave 77% of 2024 revenue, Microsoft 62%. Nothing shows CoreWeave's future depended almost entirely on OpenAI, whose $11.9B contract was new.

The 10-Q shows OpenAI can terminate if delivery fails and the build would be funded by new SPV debt. DDTL 3.0 was raised for the OpenAI contract, and DDTL 2.0 pricing was tied to customer contracts. The liquidity statement counts later loans.

The prospectus shows about $1.9B 2024 revenue, an $863M net loss, about $8B debt, and 77% of revenue from the top two customers with Microsoft at 62%. Reporting from The Information identifies Nvidia as the second at 15%.

Ars Technica reports a $20.9B operating loss and a ~$39B headline net loss, but only about $8B excluding a one-off charge, so the $14B premise depends on the measure. Nothing shows CoreWeave payments needed new funding.
